prompt: Create a side-by-side comparison image showing two versions of the same dreamy fantasy portrait. Canvas is a horizontal 16:9 split-screen composition with a perfectly vertical divide down the center, no gap, left panel and right panel each occupying exactly half the image. In both panels, depict the same ethereal young woman in a luminous fairytale garden, shown as a close-up bust portrait with pale porcelain skin, soft gray-blue eyes, delicate lips, and loosely pinned wavy brown hair. She wears an ornate pastel floral crown with pink roses, tiny crystal flowers, pearls, translucent butterfly ornaments, and soft feathers, plus dangling crystal earrings and a sheer embroidered gown with iridescent floral appliqué. Her hand is raised gently near her chin, giving a calm, romantic, slightly wistful expression while looking toward the viewer. The scene is filled with pastel blossoms, sparkling bokeh, floating dust motes, translucent butterflies, crystal petals, and soft backlit haze. Use an ultra-detailed high-fashion fantasy photography style, shallow depth of field, pearly highlights, glittering refractions, delicate skin texture, and pastel lavender, blush pink, silver, and pale blue tones. Make the left panel slightly more textured, crisp, and detailed in skin and fabric microtexture; make the right panel slightly smoother and more airbrushed, with softer pastel lighting and gentler facial texture. Add exactly 2 label boxes: one white rounded rectangle at the top left of the left panel reading OpenAI 官方, and one white rounded rectangle at the top left of the right panel reading Azure West US 3. Use clean black sans-serif text inside the labels. Keep both portraits similar enough to clearly compare rendering differences, but not identical; avoid watermarks, logos, extra captions, borders, or additional text.

promptZh: 创建一张并排对比图，展示同一张梦幻肖像的两个版本。画布为 16:9 的水平分屏构图，中间有完美的垂直分割线，无间隙，左侧面板和右侧面板各占据图像的一半。在两个面板中，描绘同一位身处明亮童话花园中的空灵年轻女子，画面为半身特写，她拥有苍白的瓷质皮肤、柔和的灰蓝色眼睛、精致的双唇以及随意盘起的波浪状棕色头发。她戴着华丽的粉彩花环，上面装饰着粉色玫瑰、微小的水晶花、珍珠、半透明蝴蝶饰品和柔软的羽毛，并佩戴着垂坠的水晶耳环，身穿带有虹彩花卉贴花的透明刺绣礼服。她的一只手轻轻抬起靠近下巴，表情平静、浪漫且略带忧郁，注视着观众。场景中充满了粉彩花朵、闪烁的焦外成像、漂浮的尘埃、半透明的蝴蝶、水晶花瓣和柔和的背光薄雾。采用超细节的高级时尚奇幻摄影风格，浅景深，珍珠般的高光，闪烁的折射，细腻的皮肤纹理，以及粉紫色、淡粉色、银色和淡蓝色的色调。左侧面板在皮肤和织物微纹理上更具质感、更清晰、更细致；右侧面板则更平滑、更具喷绘感，光线更柔和，面部纹理更细腻。添加 2 个标签框：左侧面板左上角为一个白色圆角矩形，文字为 OpenAI 官方；右侧面板左上角为一个白色圆角矩形，文字为 Azure West US 3。标签内使用简洁的黑色无衬线字体。保持两张肖像足够相似以便清晰对比渲染差异，但不要完全相同；避免出现水印、徽标、额外标题、边框或其他文本。
